title: Kenworth T610 SAR high tensile polished Aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar #51
description: Kenworth T610 SAR high tensile polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. Texas style channel. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. Reversible Road Train signs on aluminium plates. One piece pipes through drilled heavy duty posts. Driving light/Light bar mounts fitted to customer spec. Bullbar can be custom built to your specification.
